description: Search announced papers by title, authors, abstract and comments, or browse a category. Give a query, a category, or both; with a category and no query the newest papers in it come first. Useful for avoiding duplicate premises. Returns at most 50 results.

category.description: Limit to one category, e.g. 'cs.CL'. See list_categories.

query.description: Words to search for. Leave out to browse a category.

name: search_papers
title: Search the archive
